lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: تَلَظَّىٰ is in the derivative form: تَلَظَّى
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ل/ظ/ي   l–ẓ–y fire, raging fire, to burn brightly; to be mad with anger.

Of this root, 2 words occur 1 time each in the Qur’an:
تَلَظَّى talaẓẓā and لَظَى laẓā.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
تَلَظَّى talaẓẓā [imperf., with elided initial ﺘَ, of v. V intrans.] to blaze, to burn fiercely

(92:14) فَأَنْذَرْتُكُمْ‏ ‏نَارًا‏ ‏تَلَظَّى‏ so I have warned you about a raging Fire.
